column2: #Reading in .csv file from Neo2 replicon dataset
#Changing column names to the corresponding sample names using rename with splice operator
#Subset dataframe so that it only has samples that start with Conc
#Group by time and concentration and calculate the mean and sd at each timepoint
mutate(mean_RLU = mean(RLU),sd_RLU = sd(RLU)) %>% distinct(Time, concentration, .keep_all = TRUE)
# Create the main plot with the replicon data
Plot <- ggplot(Replicon_dataframe, aes(x = Time, y = mean_RLU,color=concentration)) +
